component.name: Orbitly
component.summary: Moon phase and solar system dashboard

description.p: Orbitly is a native GTK4 / libadwaita astronomy dashboard: current moon phase, planetary and deep-space probe distances, light travel times, Earth data, aurora Kp index, ISS / LEO data, people in space and a history chart. Positions are checked against NASA JPL Horizons.
More accurate positions and a clearer dashboard.

ul.li: Planet, Moon and probe positions are now checked against NASA JPL Horizons
The James Webb Space Telescope's distance is fetched live from JPL
Exact dates for the next new and full moon
Sunrise and sunset times within a couple of minutes of almanac values
Redesigned Moon card, plus new Near Earth and Deep Space cards
Ten colour themes, or follow the desktop's light and dark style
